title: Integrate combo87 on 932084c6: Opus3 dceb7bed (w-aa01 recover the live stream after recreation, proxy loss and silence; byte-identical carry of 3ad2608c)
outcome: The candidate is on master as one commit, gated by a full launcher run on the exact tree, pushed, and installed on Central and DL560.
acceptance: Commit dceb7bed42251bf3aeda89c88deac83194d777a7 (tree 7af3404da8ca6cc0dd9d3f730281f6e8cc156a9a) is on origin/master, where master was moved to it by a fast-forward from 932084c6e30569590ad55f69404d39b5e13f4e32.

A full launcher run (node scripts/test-launcher.mjs full --input commit) on a test ref whose tree is 7af3404d passed every stage, with equal source ids before and after and an eligible clean input, and no review finding of Medium or higher is outstanding: the candidate's contribution against 932084c6 is byte-identical (same 16 paths, equal pre-image and post-image blob ids, status and mode, compared without rename detection) to 3ad2608c's contribution against 8e4fd2f9, which the R3 pair Codex delegation-37749640 and Claude delegation-9416dacd reviewed with no Medium or higher finding (its Low filed as w-6f17d4ca985f), and the R1-R2 Medium findings on earlier candidates were fixed and reviewed again; the candidate adopts that pair.

The release binary built from tree 7af3404d was installed at target/release/termal(.exe) on Central and DL560, with the previous binary kept aside, and the running hosts were not restarted by the install; a later landing's install or a host restart's `cargo run --release` rebuild may since have replaced it, and only a replacing install keeps the replaced binary aside.
